T2.PARTY_TYPE3, T2.PARTY_TYPE2, T2.PARTY_TYPE1, T2.INDUSTRY, T2.INDUSTRY2, T2.INSITITUTE_CODE, T2.IS_GOV, T2.MAIN_CAPITAL, T2.REGISTER_CAPITAL, T2.PROVINCE, T2.CITY, T2.COUNTY, T2.HOLDING_TYPE, T2.STRUCT_ADJUST_TYPE, T2.INDUS_UPGRATE_TYPE, T2.BUSI_SCOPE, MAIN_BUSI, T2.SEX, T2.PERSON_ID, T2.M_PHONE, T2.PHONE, T2.POSITION, T2.COMPANY_NAME, T2.ADDRESS, T2.MAIL, T2.PROPERTY, T2.LINK_ID1, T2.LINK_ID2, T2.LINK_ID3, T2.REMARK, T2.CREATE_USER, T2.CREATE_DEPT, T2.CREATE_TIME, T2.UPDATE_USER, T2.UPDATE_TIME from MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T1 right join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO_ADD T2 on T1.CUSTOMER_ID = T2.CUSTOMER_ID ) TEMP
AND TEMP.CUSTOMER_ID like concat('%',concat(#{customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))

select sum(count) from ( select count(*) count from MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T1,MST_COUNTER_PARTY T2 where T1.CUSTOMER_ID = T2.LINK_ID and T1.CUSTOMER_ID = #{customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} union all select count(*) count from MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T3,FIN_PRODUCT T4 where T3.CUSTOMER_ID=T4.ISSUER and T3.CUSTOMER_ID= #{customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} union all select count(*) count from MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T5,FIN_PRODUCT_ADD T6 where T5.CUSTOMER_ID = T6.UNDER_WRITER_ID and T5.CUSTOMER_ID = #{customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) A

#{item.customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
